purpose: Teacher-approved recurring Portfolio visual and wording contract. Student report is locked to the approved two-page MG-grade design; teacher report is intervention-first with exactly three main lanes.
fidelity_rule: The HTML templates are canonical shells. Preserve fixed headings, lane names, table/card anatomy, and grading explanation. Data changes; recurring structure does not drift.

student_packet.duplex_rule: Every active student consumes exactly two content pages.
student_packet.unit_grade_rule: Do not display an overall Unit letter grade or large Unit-grade box.
student_packet.grading_explanation: Mastery Goal grades are current evidence, not averages, and can improve with new evidence.

mastery_goal_grade_display.assessed: Display `Grade {GRADE_CODE}` plus the course-policy label where space allows.
mastery_goal_grade_display.not_assessed: Display exactly `Not assessed`; never convert absence of evidence into Grade I.
mastery_goal_grade_display.card_rule: Every MG card shows exact MG title/description, current grade display, secure-I-Can count, and every I Can row.

mastery_goal_distribution.rule: Every MG appears exactly once. Rendered readability controls the split.

practice_box.title: Your Practice
practice_box.instruction: Scan or click to open the Practice Builder and select the following I Can statements for more practice:
practice_box.preselection: Do not preselect an I Can. The Practice Builder URL contains Unit only.
practice_box.focus_list: List every selected current practice-focus I Can as exact code + full statement.
practice_box.privacy_rule: No student identity, evidence, grade, or status in the URL/QR.
practice_box.missing_builder_rule: When the current course has no approved Practice Builder route, show the focus list without fabricating a link.

teacher_summary.class_overview: Show quick lane counts/decisions first, then Major Strengths and Top Actionable Patterns. Do not put roster-upload or PowerSchool workflow instructions on the page.

whole_class.rule: Use only for a genuinely shared classwide instructional need. If none, state that on Class Overview and omit a separate Whole Class page.

priority_day_group.rule: Group only students sharing the exact same current substantial-gap bundle of 2-4 I Cans. A single shared I Can is not enough. Each group shows all bundle I Cans with exact code + full statement, student list, shared misconception/need, and concise teacher move.

pull_in_students.rule: Student-centered list for 1-2 current small/actionable gaps. Show each student with exact I Can target(s) and concise personalized practice/check need. Never organize this page under I Can headings.

appendix.rule: Detailed I Can evidence is reference material after intervention pages. Use large cards and continue pages as needed; never clip or hide names.

human_learning_label_rule: Always display canonical code and full exact I Can statement together in human-facing output.
